name: RLAD-abstractions-benchmarks
description: RLAD-abstractions-benchmarks provides a suite of tasks and environments designed to evaluate how well agents learn and exploit abstract representations in reinforcement learning. It focuses on representation quality, state abstraction, and generalization/transfer of policies across environment variations. The benchmark supplies standardized evaluation protocols and metrics for comparing abstraction methods and downstream control performance.
reputation: An emerging research benchmark used by a small community studying abstraction and generalization in RL; limited mainstream adoption so far.
